Markets.title: Central Bank of India Q2 profit rises 21% as loans grow 30%
Markets.summary: Central Bank of India's net profit rose 21% to Rs 1,469 crore in the quarter ending September 2026, driven by a 30% expansion in loans. The bank also reported an improvement in asset quality, with net non-performing assets dropping to 0.31%.

Markets.title: Rising borrowing costs signal funding risks for global AI expansion: Jefferies report
Markets.summary: Rising borrowing costs are increasing credit risks for companies investing heavily in artificial intelligence infrastructure, such as Oracle and CoreWeave. Investors should monitor credit spreads to evaluate whether companies can continue funding these major AI projects.

Markets.title: AI race may depend more on access to power, infrastructure than chip supply: Morgan Stanley
Markets.summary: Morgan Stanley warns that the AI infrastructure market will face a 32-gigawatt electricity shortage by 2028. This impending power deficit threatens data center development and chip deployment, creating severe risks for smaller businesses in the AI race.

Markets.title: ixigo Q2 profit at Rs 63 cr on robust show in hotel booking biz
Markets.summary: Ixigo reported a consolidated net profit of Rs 63.42 crore for the September quarter, bouncing back from a net loss of Rs 3.46 crore a year ago. This financial turnaround was driven by a surge in hotel bookings, resulting in an operational revenue of Rs 320.96 crore.

Markets.title: ICICI Bank Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 20% YoY to Rs 14,843 crore, NII rises 18%
Markets.summary: ICICI Bank reported a 20.1% year-on-year increase in net profit to Rs 14,843 crore for the second quarter of financial year 2027. During the same period, the private lender's net interest income (NII) rose by 18%.

Markets.title: IDBI Bank Q2 results: Net profit tanks 39% YoY to Rs 2,205 crore; NII dips 49% YoY
Markets.summary: IDBI Bank reported a 39% year-on-year drop in net profit to Rs 2,205 crore for Q2 FY27 due to a previous one-off gain, though profit rose 14% excluding this factor. Despite the profit decline, the bank saw improved asset quality, stronger net interest margins, and double-digit growth in both deposits and advances.

Geo-Political.title: Trump waives several Russia sanctions as row with Zelensky intensifies
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump temporarily waived several recent congressional sanctions against Russia, citing national security concerns. This decision coincided with an escalating diplomatic dispute between Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.

Geo-Political.title: Oregon teacher fought school attacker before armed dad shot suspect 'multiple times'
Geo-Political.summary: A 16-year-old former student targeted a special educational needs classroom at an Oregon primary school. An armed father shot the suspect multiple times after an Oregon teacher intervened and fought the attacker.

Geo-Political.title: Three men jailed for 158 years each for murdering Australian and US surfers in Mexico
Geo-Political.summary: Three men were each sentenced to 158 years in prison for murdering two Australian brothers and their American friend during a surfing trip in Mexico. The victims were killed in an apparent botched robbery after the attackers attempted to steal their truck.

Geo-Political.title: Brazil sees record fall in Amazon deforestation as key election looms
Geo-Political.summary: Deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon dropped to a record low ahead of the country's upcoming elections. This decline marks a significant reversal from the expansion of forest loss that occurred under former president Jair Bolsonaro.

Geo-Political.title: Rare pink diamond goes on display in France 100 years after amateur heist
Geo-Political.summary: A rare French royal diamond is being displayed publicly for the first time since it was stolen in 1926. The famous gem was originally recovered a century ago after being hidden inside an apple by an amateur thief.

Geo-Political.title: Nursery owner in China jailed for life after hundreds of children poisoned
Geo-Political.summary: A Chinese nursery owner was sentenced to life in prison after she and five staff members poisoned hundreds of children. The group added inedible paint to meals to make the food look more appealing.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator found their WordPress SaaS course recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course in that category. This unexpected placement occurred without the use of paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization techniques.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

Data & Insights.summary: This weekly compilation features data-driven charts analyzing major business developments, including Jio's market debut, deferred UPI charges, and the IDBI Bank stake sale. The insights are designed to help readers better understand the key stories reported by Mint over the past week.

Data & Insights.title: 800 million jobs at risk over 15 years? World Bank's Ajay Banga calls for global financing overhaul
Data & Insights.summary: World Bank President Ajay Banga warned that 1.2 billion youth will enter the global workforce over the next 15 years while only 400 million jobs are expected. To address this and other challenges, the institution plans to increase critical minerals financing to $19 billion through fiscal 2030 and mobilize private capital.

Data & Insights.title: PM-SETU: Five ITI clusters to get  ₹1,195 crore investment from Tata Steel Foundation, BVG India, others
Data & Insights.summary: Tata Steel Foundation, BVG India, and three other companies are investing ₹1,195 crore to upgrade five ITI clusters under the PM-SETU scheme. This brings the cumulative approved investment under the initiative to ₹3,687 crore.

Data & Insights.title: Vibrant Goa summit to connect 220 Goan MSMEs with 300+ global buyers – What to expect?
Data & Insights.summary: The Government of Goa is hosting a three-day business summit from October 29 to 31 at the Dr Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Indoor Stadium. The event will connect 220 local MSMEs with over 300 global buyers and business leaders from more than 50 countries.

Data & Insights.title: ‘Most consequential change’: Kevin Warsh says AI will reshape US economy, warns of a ‘bumpy’ road ahead
Data & Insights.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh stated that artificial intelligence will reshape the US economy by boosting productivity long-term while potentially raising inflation in the short term. He also warned that uncertainty surrounding the technology and emerging markets could create a bumpy transition.

Data & Insights.title: India may hike fuel prices in November, pushing inflation above RBI target: Oxford Economist
Data & Insights.summary: Oxford Economics reports that India may moderately increase fuel prices in November before upcoming state elections. This potential price hike is expected to push national inflation above the Reserve Bank of India's target.

India.title: Why CJP's Abhijeet Dipke Walked Free While Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka Remain In Jail
India.summary: Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were sent to five-day judicial custody for entering Jantar Mantar and trying to disturb the peace despite police orders. Abhijeet Dipke was released because of a key difference in his case, according to sources.

India.title: Inform Father, Landlord: Gurugram Techie's Mail To Bosses Before Killing Wife, Himself
India.summary: A 30-year-old techie from Bengaluru killed his wife and himself in Gurugram. Before the incident, he sent an email to his bosses asking them to inform his father and landlord.

India.title: JEE Main 2027 Registration: Application Form Expected Next Week, Check Documents
India.summary: Registration for the JEE Main 2027 Session 1 exam is expected to begin next week. Candidates should prepare their required documents and review the tentative January exam schedule before applying.

India.title: Abhijeet Dipke Released After Signing 'Peace Bond' On Court Orders
India.summary: Abhijeet Dipke was arrested after planning to lead a 'Tiranga March' at Connaught Place to protest alleged electoral fraud. He was subsequently released following court orders to sign a 'peace bond'.

India.title: UDP Down To 4 In Meghalaya As Speaker Recognises 8 MLAs' Switch To BJP
India.summary: The Meghalaya Assembly Speaker has officially recognized the switch of eight United Democratic Party legislators to the BJP. This defection reduces the strength of the UDP in the state to four MLAs.

General.summary: Former UK national security adviser Lord Ricketts has warned that the country must defend itself against Russian hybrid attacks. He stated that the government should increase spending to improve the resilience of energy, transport, air traffic control, and defense sites.

General.summary: A 16-year-old boy and an 80-year-old man died when a light aircraft crashed near Loch Lomond on Friday. Emergency services responded to the incident around 16:45 and pronounced both victims dead at the scene.

General.title: Harry Styles debuts new track in memory of Liam Payne
General.summary: Pop star Harry Styles performed a new song dedicated to Liam Payne. He debuted the track on the second anniversary of Payne's death.

General.title: Toxic algorithms wouldn't let them go - now Australia wants an off switch
General.summary: The Australian government aims to protect social media users from unwanted content. It plans to introduce legislation requiring platforms to provide an off switch for toxic algorithms.
